**LOCATION:** London Geological Society, Burlington House, Piccadilly, London W1J 0BG.

**TIME:** 14:00-18:00, 10/06/2026 

Please join us for our first annual CDT showcase event. This will be an opportunity to see the research of our students and to celebrate the end of our first year. We will have a special keynote by [Ewan Kirk][https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ewan_Kirk], founder of Cantab Capital and former chair of the Isaac Newton Institute. This will be followed by a reception with poster presentations in the beautiful lower library of the Geological Society.

[Click here for further information and registration](https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/1988816539808?aff=oddtdtcreator).
